name: C++ Embedded Sensor Data Processor
short_description: Reads simulated sensor data via serial/socket communication, processes it in real-time using POSIX threads and mutexes, and outputs processed data to a terminal dashboard. Implements circular buffers
detailed_description: Reads simulated sensor data via serial/socket communication, processes it in real-time using POSIX threads and mutexes, and outputs processed data to a terminal dashboard. Implements circular buffers for efficient data handling.

software: Built with C++, Linux, POSIX Threads, Mutex, Serial I/O
Directly targets Tesla's embedded C++ + Linux requirements. Shows you can write production C++ on Linux with real-time data processing.
Demonstrates C++, OS, Linux, Embedded basics, DSA (circular buffers)
